regions.full_page: May 11% You see I made very little progress two weeks ago on the card Br. Leo gave me and suggested I write you. However, while I would like to write you more of a real letter, which in fact I proposed to do, I have found it not easy to get any where. However, I am sending you herewith a letter written to a priest who at the time was in Yonkers N.Y. and quite inclined to worry about one thing or another; - nearly always about imaginary things, i.e. sbout something that turns out to have been more or less just a temptation. Of course we are all naturally inclined that way. From our dear Lord's "Sermon on the Mount. ", you can see how the Apostles themselves were no ex- ceptions. Just reat the 5th 60 and 75 chapters of St. Matthew ani see how our dear Lord almost scolded them for their want of faith. No one blames you, selfunderstood for trying to be healthy. That's only a part of the first law of nature. But to be over anxious about it is not good; or to think that the good God should work a miracle for us. Because we ought to know that He is the only one can work a miracle. We can try of course, to induce Him e.s. through the intercession of the saints and our Bl. Mother Mary Queen of all. ... When Fr. Exprovincial Theodosious was a cleric it was generally feared he'd never last to be or- dained. ... So keep up courage dear Fr. Sebastian -- just one day at a time and leave the .morrow and yesterday to the good God. and pl pray for this poor sinner . ...
